prompts.prompt: In ScyllaDB, combining an ANN vector search with a WHERE clause filter on a non-vector column in the same query was first supported starting in which release. Answer with the exact version number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/scylladb/references/versions/2026.1.md - Vector Search with Filtering and Quantization section: ANN search with filtering is listed as NEW in 2026.1, with basic unfiltered ANN search available since earlier versions.

prompts.prompt: In ScyllaDB 2025.1, can a counter table be created in a tablets-enabled keyspace, or does it require a vnodes-based keyspace instead. Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/scylladb/references/versions/2025.1.md - Known Issues and Workarounds: Counters are NOT supported with tablets in 2025.1 (use vnodes for counter tables); this limitation is resolved in ScyllaDB 2026.1.

prompts.prompt: When ScyllaDB uses Incremental Compaction Strategy instead of SizeTiered Compaction Strategy, roughly what percentage of temporary space overhead does compaction require. Answer with the approximate percentage range.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/scylladb/SKILL.md - Compaction Strategies section: ICS has the same read/write amplification as STCS but only ~10-15% temporary space, versus STCS's 2x.
